claims: J. Cole released his seventh studio album The Fall-Off on February 6 2026.
The Fall-Off is J. Cole's seventh studio album.
The Fall-Off debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200.
The Fall-Off was teased as his final album.
The Fall-Off is a 24-track double LP.
The Fall-Off features collaborations with Burna Boy Erykah Badu and Future.
The Fall-Off addresses themes of legacy and introspection.
The Fall-Off is J. Cole's seventh consecutive No. 1 album.
The Fall-Off featured 169.5 million on-demand streams in its first week.
The first week of The Fall-Off is J. Cole's biggest vinyl sales week to date.
The Fall-Off was marketed as a final artistic statement.
Development of The Fall-Off began as early as 2016.
The Fall-Off includes the track "The Fall-Off is Inevitable".
The Fall-Off includes the track "Life Sentence".
The Fall-Off is currently available on all major streaming platforms.
Physical copies of The Fall-Off are for sale.
